_comment: EVM block-production quorum roster for Datachain Rope's Testimony-timed Engine API driver (rope-engine-driver). Each entry's pubkey_hex is the SAME Ed25519 identity that node already registered for the native Quipu Canon consensus layer (~/.rope/validator_key.bin) -- not a second, parallel key. To onboard a future node: run `rope-engine-driver print-pubkey` on it, append an entry here, redistribute this file to every node in the committee (including the new one), and restart each attester service. See deploy/scripts/onboard-evm-quorum-node.sh.
